scope: spatial primitives, not full combat eligibility or action execution
source: Specification v0.9: Map, MVP projectiles/swarms/interface; approved design sections4 and11

checks.requirement: Hex conversion, metric and board bounds
testNames: roundtrips odd-row offsets, including negative rows
has unit centre spacing and cube-distance symmetry/triangle inequality
validates geometry boundaries and inputs

checks.requirement: Size 1–10 compact footprints and minimum occupied range
testNames: Size %i has the exact compact footprint
measures nearest occupied range, rather than centre distance
recognizes opposite sectors without facing

checks.requirement: Boundary side and deterministic line tracing
testNames: traces a straight ray and stores the boundary side choice
produces connected rays reversible by exchanging sides
retains ray side, occupants and wall decisions through scenario serialization

checks.requirement: Edge walls, crystal sight and arc exception
testNames: canonicalizes interior and boundary edges and rejects non-neighbours
crystal permits sight but blocks projectiles; ordinary walls block both
applies %s wall movement geometry independently of damage
rejects new solid walls through occupied footprints, duplicates and wholly outside edges
rejects clipped large footprints, overlaps and wall straddling
stops at last legal position without rerouting or swapping
finds deterministic nearest legal cells and reports no-space cases

checks.requirement: Transit versus endpoints and belief exceptions
testNames: allows flying and incorporeal transit but requires legal resting footprints
lets Nimble transit allies and mindless creatures ignore illusion blockers

checks.requirement: Swarm spatial overlap and restraint eligibility
testNames: supports swarm overlap, same-height coverage and immediate size-dependent release
counts large area victims once and permits grounded-only selection
allows rider/mount sharing but not unrelated occupants

checks.requirement: Projectile origin, interception and target height
testNames: intercepts allies before targets, while creatures do not block sight
starts at origin boundary and respects target height and rider selection

checks.requirement: Two-hex inset seeded starts for 2–8 players
testNames: places %i wizards evenly on the inset perimeter
rejects invalid player counts and too-small boards
